name: cherrytake
description: Cut silences and place a client's revision notes as markers in Adobe Premiere Pro by asking ChatGPT. Drives the CherryTake panel on your Mac; every cut goes to a copy of the sequence.

interface.shortDescription: Cut silences and place client notes in Premiere Pro
interface.longDescription: CherryTake lets ChatGPT check Adobe Premiere Pro, analyze silences, cut them on a copy of the sequence, undo the last cut, and place a client's revision notes as markers after you confirm each one. Requires the CherryTake Core panel open in Premiere Pro on this Mac.
defaultPrompt: Analyze the silences in my sequence
Place these client notes as markers
